R_lts_inland.name: Inland Harbor Phase
R_lts_inland.description: Managed, automated, safe post-purpose society. UBI and AI systems make life stable but emotionally flattening.
R_lts_inland.text: Inland Harbor Phase — Managed, automated, safe post-purpose society; life is stable, comfortable, and emotionally flattening rather than ruined. Visual palette: soft gray-blue, civic glass, rain sheen, restrained public-service UI glow, controlled practical lighting.

R_lts_threshold.name: Threshold / Floodwall
R_lts_threshold.description: The boundary where tide-running leaves the managed city: old ferry lot, staging area, flood steps, tide boards.
R_lts_threshold.text: Threshold / Floodwall — Boundary where tide-running leaves the managed city: old ferry lot, staging area, flood steps, tide boards. Visual palette: wet asphalt, cold mist, vehicle headlights, contractor white light, dark concrete; practical light only.

R_lts_flats.name: The Flats
R_lts_flats.description: Exposed seabed crossing: mud, old pavement, channels, broken pilings, fog, returning water.
R_lts_flats.text: The Flats — Exposed seabed crossing of black tidal mud, old pavement, channels, broken pilings, shell debris, fog, and returning water. Visual palette: black mud, teal pools, bone shell, sodium reflection, fog gray. Physical, cold, real, and difficult underfoot; never supernatural.

R_lts_reach.name: The Reach
R_lts_reach.description: Abandoned offshore districts: fixed physical geography exposed by low tides. Dangerous because real, not because supernatural.
R_lts_reach.text: The Reach — Fixed abandoned offshore districts exposed by low tides; dangerous because of real water, mud, distance, weather, and decaying infrastructure, never supernatural. Visual palette: wet concrete, rust orange, black water, deep cyan, faded institutional green; practical light swallowed by fog.
